name: What photos or records do I need before and after refreshing a foreclosed kitchen?
description: Take before-and-after photos of every area, especially damage, appliances, cabinets, and sinks. Keep a simple log of what was removed and what was repaired.

mainEntity.name: What photos or records do I need before and after refreshing a foreclosed kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most important evidence is before-and-after photos, especially of the kitchen, cabinets, appliances, sinks, and any damage. For foreclosed properties, keep a clear record of what was removed, what was repaired, and any disposal or cleanup details so the condition of the space is easy to verify.
